notify: Each affected Florida resident, by mail or email

trigger: After investigation and consultation with law enforcement, the business reasonably determines the breach has not and will not likely result in identity theft or other financial harm

obligation: Florida notice to consumer reporting agencies
trigger: Notice required to more than 1,000 individuals at a single time
